title: The PublishPress Capabilities: User Role Access Control, Admin Area Permissions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The PublishPress Capabilities plugin for WordPress, up to and including version 2.53.0, is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'page_elements' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when an administrator interacts with the Profile Features screen. The attack requires the administrator to save attacker-supplied data, which appears as normal use and leaves no visible indication of compromise.
